spec: DESIGN.md — firmware: the console region one game's disc decides, read the way each emulator reads it (#661)
description: Firmware questions that name the game's content. A group the console region selects states the region the emulator's own rule decides for that content and where it came from, and its verdict becomes the one option's whose regions hold it; where nothing was decided the group stays per region and core-mode-unestablished says why. Discs are modeled at the seam (disc_identities), never as images.

vectors.name: swanstation-a-disc-s-licence-decides-the-option-its-launch-needs
vectors.rationale: SwanStation's region option ships Auto, so the console region is the disc's own (system.cpp:638-655 at 4d309c0). Asked about one game, the core's own rule reads that disc: its licence string is the North American one, so the group states ntsc-u from the licence, and its verdict is the NTSC-U option's — the named image is there.
